from_a: Each ad platform's spend export, by day and campaign
from_b: Product analytics (PostHog, GA4), by the visit's source and campaign
expect: A steady share of clicks, a little under all of them
a_gap_usually_means: The landing page is down or slow, a redirect strips the tags, a new campaign went live without them, or the analytics tag was removed

count_a: Qualified submissions the platform should have logged
from_a: The submission store: qualified, the visitor didn't opt out of tracking, and, for Google, its PRO source is Google (Meta receives every source's qualified conversion)
from_b: Google Ads' qualified conversion action; Meta Events Manager's Lead events, not Ads Manager's results
expect: Very close to all of them, if not exactly
a_gap_usually_means: The tag or the Conversions API stopped sending (a site update, an expired token), the event fires on a page load, or it fires twice without the event ID

count_a: Web submissions in the submission store
from_a: The submission store (a Google Sheet or a web-connected database), written before anything else
from_b: The CRM export, capture method web_form
expect: Close to all of them, short only by the CRM's duplicate and spam rules
a_gap_usually_means: The connection to the CRM failed, a form isn't wired to the CRM, or a duplicate or spam rule is catching real leads

count_a: Inbound calls of a set length or more
from_a: The call tracking system, every call to the tracking numbers
from_b: The CRM export, capture method phone_call
expect: A steady share of the longer calls
a_gap_usually_means: Calls answered and never logged as leads, a tracking number missing from the form map, or a number routing to the wrong line
